title: 第九章 、空间门？任意门？神奇拐杖
slug: 末日求生欧皇女配在线摇人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“那些人貌似叫她大小姐。”

韩建华是躲到一边偷听大伙讲话，没有和那十人一起出现。

“就是那人，你败给她不冤枉，那人手底下有一帮狗腿子，个个实力都不错，自身运气也高，拥有一把厉害的诡器伴身。”

“那就这么放过她。”

韩建华不甘心，好不容易哄外甥女给他一个保命道具，就被那女人一下子给消耗掉，日后无意中踩进里世界，就要拿命去搏。

“哼，这次现放过她，等我们将其他厉害的诡域拿下，自身实力强大起来，何愁多付不了一个千金大小姐。”

不过是家世比她好，提前踩在巨人身上看世界吧。

有前世的经历和自身的对赌系统外挂在，黑曼妮不觉得自己还会比对方差多少。

“阿嚏~”

“大小姐，你没事吧？”

端木棠梨连续打了几个喷嚏，米樱昭雪紧张看着，生怕是由于自身原因，害得小姐妹身体受伤。

“无事，我们开始做游戏，把道具亮出来，看对这场游戏有何帮助？”

碍于在人前，米樱昭雪需要尊称端木棠梨为大小姐，不好太亲密，端木棠梨说自己没事，她只能按捺下内心的焦虑，将视线放到游戏上面。

“大伙知道，我的道具都被壮汉拿走的道具，只能依靠大小姐。”

米樱昭雪双手一摊，表示自己毫无收货。

其他人都看到米樱昭雪被壮汉捶打，手里像鸡一样的道具被收走的一幕，对于她的说法没有任何怀疑。

实际上端木棠梨解决完那位突然冒出来的壮汉，壮汉手里就掉出来两份道具，其中一份就是米樱昭雪发现的道具——尖叫鸡。

【名字：尖叫鸡】

【类别：诡器】

【等级：1】

【效果：别惹我，小心我叫得你魂飞魄散，使用该道具，可以直击敌人灵魂之力，冷却时间三十分钟，使用尖叫鸡时间越久，精神力损耗越大，精神力一旦低破极点，容易诡化。】

另外一个道具则是拳王手套，应该是壮汉自己发现的道具。

Page (1/3)

"Those people seem to call her Miss."

Han Jianhua hid aside to eavesdrop on everyone's conversation and did not appear with the ten people.

"That's that person. It's not unfair for you to lose to her. That person has a bunch of thugs under his command. They are all very strong. They are also very lucky. They have a powerful weapon with them."

"Then just let her go."

Han Jianhua was unwilling to give in and finally coaxed his niece to give him a life-saving tool, but it was consumed by the woman all at once. If he accidentally stepped into the other world in the future, he would risk his life.

"Hmph, let her go now this time. When we take down the other powerful Guiyu, and our own strength becomes stronger, there is no need to worry about paying for a rich lady."

But her family background is better than hers, so let’s step on giants and see the world in advance.

With her past life experience and her own gambling system cheat, Hei Manni didn't think she would be much worse than her opponent.

"Ah sneeze~"

"Miss, are you okay?"

Duanmu Tangli sneezed several times in succession, while Miying Zhaoxue watched nervously, fearing that the little sister would be injured due to her own reasons.

"Nothing, let's start playing the game and show the props to see how they will help the game."

Due to being in front of others, Miying Zhaoxue had to address Duanmu Tangli as eldest lady and not to be too intimate. Duanmu Tangli said that she was fine, so she could only suppress her inner anxiety and focus on the game.

"Everyone knows that all my props have been taken away by strong men, so I can only rely on the eldest lady."

Miying Zhaoxue spread her hands and said that she had no receipt.

Everyone else saw the scene where Miying Zhaoxue was beaten by a strong man and the chicken-like prop in her hand was taken away, and they had no doubts about her statement.

In fact, after Duanmu Tangli dealt with the strong man who suddenly appeared, two props fell out of the strong man's hand, one of which was the prop discovered by Mi Ying Zhaoxue - the Screaming Chicken.

[Name: Screaming Chicken]

[Category: Artifact]

[Level: 1]

[Effect: Don't mess with me, be careful I'll scream you out of your wits. Using this item, you can directly attack the enemy's soul power. The cooling time is thirty minutes. The longer you use the Screaming Chicken, the greater the loss of mental power. Once the mental power is low, it will easily become devious.】

Another prop is the boxing champion's gloves, which should be a prop discovered by the strong man himself.
